current_support.boundary: Signed mixed-code/data inputs and bounded JSON/NDJSON/XML/calendar format validation exist; these are structural checks.
The generic Doctor path deliberately retains a residual whenever task data exists, and only considers modify effects on existing Python outputs.
Generic local-keyword and imported-alias repairs plus a separately reviewed WSGI header contract exist; they do not prove arbitrary task behavior.
Imported-alias repair currently requires flat Python module paths, level-zero direct local imports, and the reviewed inert signature/expression grammar.

other_boundaries: XML syntax is supported, but MJCF physics/optimization needs an explicit numerical/simulator contract; an XML edit or successful Lean compilation would not prove fitness.
The reviewed software-contract scalars exclude floats; current integer-offset proof lowering is not a general numeric-program proof frontend.
Current Doctor source partition requires a single signed task. Data-aware multi-task composition needs a separate reviewed contract before parallel operators may claim joint coverage.

recommended_gaps.coverage_limit: Enables a generic finite transformation class. It does not establish scheduler feasibility, optimization or a benchmark reward.
recommended_gaps.formal_contract: Bind reviewed intent, complete input hashes, projection specification, schema, bounds and candidate output hashes. Use finite record correspondence with an independent native checker; optional Lean finite-map theorem is scoped to the declared projection, not inferred intent.
recommended_gaps.gap: No admitted input-to-output record correspondence contract connects NDJSON parsing to Doctor repair; created data outputs therefore remain residual.
recommended_gaps.kind: typed data contract and deterministic create-output operator
recommended_gaps.minimal_scope: Bounded scalar-only records with an explicitly reviewed field-copy/rename projection, exact record identities, order, cardinality, missing/null and duplicate policies. Stage one declared output; reject unreviewed filtering, aggregation or float semantics.
reuse: contracts: DataContract, SchemaContract, BoundedPredicate and provenance
property_cache: source/snapshot/contract/compiler/checker binding with fresh checks
Existing isolated candidate staging, signed admission, current-source fences and publication
tests: Authored two-record rename/copy creates only the declared output and reaches the actual Doctor candidate route with model calls forbidden.
Missing/extra/swapped records, duplicate identities/keys, absent-vs-null and altered values fail the independent correspondence checker.
Forged declaration/proof, changed input or candidate hash, undeclared path and stale cache never publish.
An uncovered transformation retains the existing residual reason; parsing or a learned nomination alone never supplies authority.

recommended_gaps.coverage_limit: Improves a narrow call-binding repair class. It does not prove donor behavior or bypass the separate task-data contract gap.
recommended_gaps.formal_contract: A unique qualified module/export resolves the existing alias; callee-only edits preserve all argument expressions/order and satisfy the declared signature. Recheck the whole dependency graph and source hashes at materialization.
recommended_gaps.gap: Flat-module-only alias source resolution rejects otherwise closed package layouts; the public catalog already declares nested Python source paths.
recommended_gaps.minimal_scope: Resolve explicit absolute and relative imports over a complete signed finite package graph, initially only inert __init__ modules and existing alias-call edits. Never import source code to discover bindings.
tests: Authored nested package and relative-import examples produce the same independently replayed binding and signature claims as the flat-module positive.
Namespace ambiguity, package/module collisions, star/dynamic imports, import cycles, __init__ side effects and shadowed builtins stay residual.
Donor deletion/change, package replacement, symlink escape and late candidate mutation refuse publication.
Actual indexed planning -> Doctor -> Lean/Z3 binding proof -> staged candidate remains provider-free and preserves the original checkout.

recommended_gaps.coverage_limit: Could cover a finite scheduling class after explicit public intent contracts are supplied. No claim about the full requirements or reward of either catalog scheduling task.
recommended_gaps.formal_contract: Lower reviewed interval constraints to bounded integer arithmetic. Independently replay each model witness: identity/cardinality, duration, release/deadline, half-open overlap, availability and capacity. Treat UNSAT, unknown and timeout separately; optimality requires an independently checked objective/lower-bound contract.
recommended_gaps.gap: Calendar validation checks framing only; no integrated Doctor lowering/checker covers event times or resource-capacity schedules. Runtime resource scheduling is not a semantic checker for task outputs.
recommended_gaps.kind: data frontend, scheduling contract and witness checker
recommended_gaps.minimal_scope: Finite explicit UTC events or integer-tick jobs within a declared horizon: IDs, duration, release/deadline, availability and capacity. Start without recurrence, timezone conversion, floating-point cost models or implicit preferences.
tests: Authored feasible and impossible schedules pass/fail by independent witness replay, with no hidden verifier input.
Boundary-touching intervals, duplicated IDs, missing jobs, duration changes and over-capacity witnesses are rejected or accepted according to the explicit half-open contract.
Reject unsupported TZID/RRULE/floating times rather than silently flattening them; calendar export must round-trip to the same typed event facts.
Solver timeout/unknown, forged SAT model, changed source/intent contract and stale cache remain residual without execution or completion authority.

scope: Read-only implementation and public profile metadata audit. Proposed work, not implemented or task-qualified.
shared_requirements: Select operators from reviewed typed applicability contracts and source evidence, never benchmark task names or hidden test contents.
Keep extraction, autoencoder/embedding nomination, logic syntax checks, solver execution and independent task validation distinct.
Every new checker must bind source, input data, intent interpretation, assumptions, bounds, compiler and output; cache hits need fresh source/checker replay.
Reuse ipfs_datasets_py for data/logic owners and keep ipfs_accelerate_py as the admitted supervisor consumer.
Retain signed planning, mutation scope, staged worktrees, process custody and local resource admission unchanged.
